t: This is GoodSAM, a mobile app. It's not a place you can walk around, but a tool, and its founder, Mark Wilson, is a British medical professional. That background is the point: an app created by someone from the medical world is shaped by the needs of emergencies and care. The material I have doesn't say more about how it works, so I won't guess. Consider this a stop where a piece of technology with a clinical origin is based.
